internal.title: flagd Service Error Rate Spike and Escalation
internal.body: On 2026-11-08 at 11:22 UTC, an alert was triggered for a high error rate in the flagd service. Initial diagnosis rounds focused on frontend and frontend-proxy components but found no evidence of faults or abnormal metrics. Due to lack of conclusive evidence, the incident was escalated to the on-call engineer at 11:41 UTC for further investigation. No recovery or root cause was identified during this period.
